**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

PhaseBio carries no most-favoured-nation obligation in SFJ's favour. My searches across the full agreement for MFN language, "favorable"/"more favorable", best-terms, matching rights, rights of first refusal or negotiation, and comparable/equivalent-terms mechanics returned only one hit: the Section 7.5 security-interest covenant at p0543, which requires a replacement lender's subordination agreement to be "not less favorable in any material respect to SFJ" than the SVB subordination agreement. That is a refinancing/subordination benchmark against a single named document, not an obligation to pass SFJ terms granted to third parties or to match third-party offers, so it does not engage MFN.

The Licensing Transaction covenant (7.5.5) is a consent-plus-Material-Impact mechanic rather than a best-terms or right-to-match construct; it falls outside this rule and is not flagged here. No redline was proposed, consistent with the preferred position that Customer bears no MFN obligation.
